The main takeaway from our work is that
ILs are not only good solvents, but also very efficient precipitating agents for cellulose.

the IL is an ideal solvent for cellulose in terms of solubility and dissolution rate, but it is not a good solvent for the metal salt, which precipitates out of solution upon addition to the cellulose solution.
